Question1:
 Q1. Find the Second Largest Element
Write a Java program to find the **second largest distinct element** in an integer array.

**Input:**
`{12, 45, 7, 89, 34, 89, 56}`

**Expected Output:**
`Second largest element: 56`

Code:
package weeklyAssignment;

public class Program_SecondLargestElement {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		int[]num= {12, 45, 7, 89, 34, 89, 56};
		System.out.println("Second largest element: ");
		int temp=0;
		for(int i=0;i<num.length;i++)
		{
			for(int j=i+1;j<num.length;j++)
			{
				if(num[i]<num[j])
				{
					temp=num[i];
					num[i]=num[j];
					num[j]=temp;
				}
			}
		}
		if(num[0]==num[1])
		{
			System.out.println(num[2]);
		}
		else
        System.out.println(num[1]);
	}

}

Output:
Second largest element: 
56

Question2:
Q2. Move All Zeros to the End
Write a Java program to move all zeros to the end of an array while maintaining the relative order of the non-zero elements.

**Input:**
{0, 5, 0, 3, 8, 0, 2, 9}`

**Expected Output:**
`Array after moving zeros: 5 3 8 2 9 0 0 0

Code:
package weeklyAssignment;

public class Program_MoveAllZeroToEnd {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		int arr[]= {0, 5, 0, 3, 8, 0, 2, 9};
		System.out.print("Array after moving zeros:");
		int index=0;
		for(int i=0;i<arr.length;i++)
		{
			if(arr[i]!=0)
			{
			arr[index]=arr[i];
			index++;
			}
		}
		while(index<arr.length)
		{
			arr[index]=0;
					index++;
		}
		for(int i=0;i<arr.length;i++)
		{
			System.out.print(" "+arr[i]);
		}
	}

}

Output:
Array after moving zeros: 5 3 8 2 9 0 0 0

Question3:
Q3. Find the Missing Number

Write a Java program to find the missing number in an array containing distinct numbers from 1 to 10, with one number missing.

Input:
{1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10}

Expected Output:
Missing number: 4

Code:
package weeklyAssignment;

public class Program_MissingNumber {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		int arr[]= {1,2,3,5,6,7,8,9};
		System.out.print("Missing Number: ");
		int n=arr.length+1;
		int expectedSum = n*(n+1)/2;
		int sum=0;
		for(int i=0;i<arr.length;i++)
		{
			sum=sum+arr[i];
		}
      System.out.print(expectedSum-sum);
	}

}

Output:
Missing Number: 4

Question 4:
Q4. Find Common Elements in Two Arrays

Write a Java program to find the common elements between two integer arrays. Print each common element only once.

Input:

Array 1: {10, 20, 30, 40, 50}
Array 2: {30, 40, 60, 70, 50}

Expected Output:
Common elements: 30 40 50

Q5. Separate Positive and Negative Numbers

Code:
package dailyAssignment;

public class Program_CommonElementArray {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		
		int []num1= {10,20,30,40,50};
		int []num2= {30,40,60,70,50};
		System.out.print("Common elements: ");
		
		for(int i=0;i<num1.length;i++)
		{
			for(int j=0;j<num2.length;j++)
			{
				if(num1[i]==num2[j])
				{
				System.out.print(num1[i]+" ");
				}
			}
			
		}
		

	}

}

Output:
Common elements: 30 40 50 

Question 5:
Q5. Separate Positive and Negative Numbers

Write a Java program to print all positive numbers first, followed by all negative numbers and zeros, while maintaining the original order within each group.

Input:
{-4, 7, 0, -2, 9, 0, -8, 5}

Expected Output:
7 9 5 -4 -2 -8 0 0

Code:
package weeklyAssignment;

public class Program_SeparatePositiveNagativeNumber {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		int arr[]= {7, 9, 5, -4, -2, -8, 0, 0};
		for(int i=0;i<arr.length;i++)
		{
			if(arr[i]>0)
			{
				System.out.print(arr[i]+" ");
			}
		}
		for(int i=0;i<arr.length;i++)
		{
			if(arr[i]<0)
			{
				System.out.print(arr[i]+" ");
			}
		}
		for(int i=0;i<arr.length;i++)
		{
			if(arr[i]==0)
			{
				System.out.print(arr[i]+" ");
			}
		}
		
		

	}

}


Output:
7 9 5 -4 -2 -8 0 0
